description: This file defines functions related to extension name enumeration, retrieval, and behavior management within the ANGLE project, including extension lookup by name, string conversion, and enablement checks.

methods.name: GetExtensionNameString
methods.description: Returns the string name of a given extension enum value.

methods.name: GetExtensionByName
methods.description: Returns the extension enum value corresponding to a given extension name string.

methods.name: GetBehaviorString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a given extension behavior enum.

methods.name: IsExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific extension is enabled based on its behavior settings.
